scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint:cache
scripts.astro:build: npm --prefix astro run build && node scripts/generate-markdown-pages.mjs
scripts.astro:cf:validate: node scripts/validate-site-history.mjs && npm run astro:build && node scripts/validate-cloudflare-dist.mjs
scripts.astro:cf:deploy:preview: npm run astro:cf:validate && cd astro && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "${CF_PAGES_PROJECT:-d-media}" --branch "${CF_PAGES_PREVIEW_BRANCH:-preview}"
scripts.astro:cf:deploy:production: npm run astro:cf:validate && cd astro && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "${CF_PAGES_PROJECT:-d-media}" --branch "${CF_PAGES_PRODUCTION_BRANCH:-main}"
